decisions.quote: Three-level, linear growth models (time-student-school) were used to estimate treatment effects, found for print awareness, elision, rhyming, and the screener (print and letter knowledge, phonological awareness), replicating previous findings for the screener, rhyming, and print knowledge, and extending them to elision.
decisions.reason: No prior adjudication or state file exists for this work. The supplied primary text contains only the publisher abstract, acknowledgments, and funding note, with no in-text citations or reference list. The abstract states that the randomized trial replicated previous findings for the screener, rhyming, and print knowledge, and the acknowledgments state that the article 'extends findings from data provided in previously published reports.' Although shipped row 8 (Bailet, Repper, Piasta, & Murphy, 2009, 10.1177/0022219409335218, 'Emergent Literacy Intervention for Prekindergarteners at Risk for Reading Failure') is an earlier intervention report from the same program, the unresolved question is which specific published report(s) are cited in the full text as the source of the replicated screener, rhyming, and print knowledge findings, and whether input_row_index 8 is the sole replicated target or whether additional prior reports are also retested.
